info.cls_ename: Continuing Education Bachelor's Program of Interior Design

description.describe_ch: 本課程授課內容，將著重於公共藝術相關法令介紹、作品導覽與實際流程操作。授課時將比較中西方公共藝術之異同與文化差異所呈現之城市面貌。並針對公共藝術設置之流程作一完整介紹與實務操作。
description.describe_eh: This course emphasizes the introduction to laws and rules related to public art, guided tours for artworks, and hands-on participation. In the classes, the differences and similarities between Chinese and western public arts will be compared, as well as the different urban visages due to cultural varieties. The process and operation of installing public art will also be coherently covered.

targets.describe_ch: 「文化藝術獎助條例」相關公共藝術條文之介紹與講解。
targets.describe_en: Introduction and Explanation of the rules related to Cultural and Art Grant Regulation.

targets.describe_ch: 中西方代表性公共藝術作品介紹與導覽，並探究其文化背景與時空環境，所產生不同之詮釋方式。
targets.describe_en: Introduction and guided appreciation for representative Chinese and western public art works. Different interpretations resulting from their cultural and historical backgrounds will be discussed.

targets.describe_ch: 公共藝術設置計畫書製作與撰寫。
targets.describe_en: The making and writing of public art installation proposal.

targets.describe_ch: 體驗公共藝術之美與了解設置工程整體施作流程。
targets.describe_en: Experiencing the beauty of public art and understanding the complete process of installation
